programs.title: The Real Housewives of London
programs.desc: The women arrive in Scotland hoping for kilts and calm, but it doesn’t last. Juliet Angus and Amanda try to play nice, Panthea and Juliet Angus grow closer, and highland games offer a rare moment of peace. But a luxe dinner explodes when Amanda accuses Panthea of stereotyping and takes aim at Juliet Angus’s parenting. Karen reaches her breaking point, and the group unravels. Walkouts, tears, and late-night reflection follow, as everyone wonders who’s still worth fighting for.
